description: Phase 1B leave-one-source-out split: hold out NACT (source/center proxy), train on the other sources. Larger, more reliable hold-out than n=4 NACT.

selection.note: Source==center proxy in MAMA-MIA; this approximates external-institution shift, not the true hidden Test A/B. Promotion-grade only if hold-out is large enough and the four metric groups are jointly satisfied vs the primary baseline.
